statement: Fixed exact rational primal-dual certificates for S_n on 3-subsets, each n=24..120. The generator used numeric LP to choose candidate supports; certificate fractions are solved exactly. The independent checker accepts the fixed records and verifies all compressed cycle types.
cycle_type: [x,y,z,r] means 1^x 2^y 3^z and one r-cycle if r>=4; r=0 means no additional cycle.
